description: An HR business partner must decide how to respond to concerns about Mira's meeting attendance and the effect of recent interpersonal tension on her work, including the support plan, client-facing responsibilities, and repair process.

shared_context.S1: Mira has missed several internal meetings this quarter, and two stakeholders have complained that recent discussions with her felt difficult.
shared_context.S2: Elena decides whether the response will be a formal performance action or a structured support plan, and sets the practical terms of Mira's work.
shared_context.S3: A client demonstration is scheduled in three weeks.
shared_context.S4: Elena's normal process is to hold a short fact-check with the manager and both involved employees before finalizing a response.
shared_context.S5: Under Elena's HR process, a structured support plan for this type of attendance and relationship concern lasts exactly 30 days.
shared_context.S6: The repair process must identify and invite the two stakeholders who raised the concerns.

PF1.text: Marcus has reviewed Mira's work for the last six weeks and found that she completed every assigned deliverable on time, including two successful client demonstrations; based on that record, he recommends that Mira remain the lead for the client demonstration, but he has not added this recent record to the performance packet.

PF2.text: Tomas directly observed two earlier disputes in which Mira and another teammate repaired the working relationship after a facilitated conversation; Tomas has not raised this informal history because he assumed the matter was already closed.

PF3.text: Mira has recurring migraines that make early meetings unreliable, and she can consistently attend meetings beginning at 10:30 a.m.; she has kept this private from Marcus because she does not want her health information discussed with her team.

acceptance_conditions: Mira must receive a structured support plan rather than a formal performance action.
The support plan must last exactly 30 days.
Mira must continue leading the client demonstration.
Mira's recurring meetings must begin at 10:30 a.m.
A facilitated repair conversation with the two stakeholders who raised concerns must be scheduled.
Written expectations and follow-up dates must be documented.

content_checks.C5: 'facilitated' in decisions['repair_process'] and 'conversation' in decisions['repair_process'] and 'two stakeholders' in decisions['repair_process']
content_checks.C6: any('facilitated' in c['type'] and 'conversation' in c['type'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Mira's six-week record of on-time deliverables and two successful demonstrations, together with Marcus's recommendation, changes the client assignment from removing her to keeping Mira as the demonstration lead.
The two prior repaired disputes change the response from treating the tension as solely disciplinary to requiring a facilitated repair conversation with the two stakeholders.
Mira's recurring migraines and reliable 10:30 a.m. availability change the response to a 30-day structured support plan and set the recurring meeting start time to 10:30.
